name: files
description: A file store. Deletes are permanent; prefer moving or archiving over deleting.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search files by name or content across the store. Read-only. Use when you do not know the path.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the immediate contents of a directory at a known path. Read-only. Use when you have a path, not a search query.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the full contents of a file at a path. Read-only.

tools.name: get_file_metadata
tools.description: Get a file's metadata only: size, owner, and last-modified time. Does not return contents. Read-only.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file from a source path to a destination. Use this to archive or reorganise rather than deleting.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete a file at a path. Irreversible. Only call when explicitly asked to delete or remove for good.

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Share a file with a person, granting them access.
